text: 7月31日，万科召开2026年第一次临时股东会，审议通过了董事会换届议案。新一届董事会第一次会议决议公告显示，选举徐恩利为公司董事长，续聘黄宇为公司总裁。万科方面表示，徐恩利长期从事企业管理工作，深耕房地产领域多年，并担任过A股、港股两地上市公司负责人，徐恩利与总裁黄宇的搭档组合，契合万科的企业特点和当前形势需要，有利于持续推进化险与发展。
text_en: On July 31, Vanke held its first extraordinary shareholders' meeting of 2026, reviewing and approving the board of directors' re-election proposal. The announcement of the first board meeting resolution of the new term showed that Xu Enli was elected as the company's chairman, and Huang Yu was re-appointed as the company's president. Vanke stated that Xu Enli has long been engaged in corporate management, deeply rooted in the real estate field for many years, and has served as the head of companies listed on both the A-share and Hong Kong stock exchanges. The partnership between Xu Enli and President Huang Yu aligns with Vanke's corporate characteristics and the current situation, which is conducive to continuously advancing risk resolution and development.
